reason: I do magic for a living, and a phone mind-reading effect in Hebrew that I can do close-up at birthdays is worth far more than 99 ₪ to me. I'd try the free tricks first, and if they fool my own family I'd buy before my next booking.
objection: On a real gig I can't let it fail in front of everyone. An app installed from the browser instead of the App Store makes me worry it breaks after a phone update, or that the guest sees the method.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks glitch or look obviously fake when I test them on friends, I won't pay.
